text:
Marco (release-lead): Heads-up: deploying release/rc-3 to prod in 45m. Rolling canary -> full. Need quick preflight sign-offs and smoke owners.
Tara (oncall): I can be on-call during the window. ETA to be at my desk at T-15.
Sanjay (infra): I'll own infra and rollout routing. Confirmed LB swap practice in the runbook.
Jen (platform QA): QA will run the smoke suite immediately after canary. Who's running quick perf checks?
Marco (release-lead): @Sanjay you and I can run perf. Jen, can you list the smoke checklist items you want us to prioritize?
Jen (platform QA): Minimal set: 1) /generate end-to-end (50 short requests) 2) prefix cache warmup check 3) token-rate P99 < 350ms for canary 4) injection/fallback checks.
Sanjay (infra): noted. I'll also validate KV cache metrics and GPU memory headroom.
Marco (release-lead): Rollback readiness: we will have v2.9 pinned as immediate fallback. Rollback steps in runbook: runbook v3 ->
```
# rollback quick
1) Flip router to v2.9 lane
2) Scale canary down to 0
3) Re-deploy any updated infra changes
```
Marco (release-lead): @Tara confirm you have permissions to execute steps 1-2 if needed.
Tara (oncall): Confirmed. I've practiced the flip once during last rehearsal.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: release/rc-3 by marco at 1905556761 (canary window 10m). Ticket: INF-4829.
Jen (platform QA): I'll queue the smoke harness now and leave the results channel open. Expecting first pass ~T+8m after canary.
Sanjay (infra): Preflight checklist I ran: infra health OK, autoscaler healthy, NVML metrics green. One note: slow startup from node pool A yesterday — will watch.
Marco (release-lead): Thanks. If smoke passes, Jen thumbs up here and we proceed to full ramp. If any perf regressions >10% or errors >1% we abort and roll back.
Jen (platform QA): Understood. I will post a short summary: pass/fail + any flaky traces.
Tara (oncall): I'll monitor alerts and be ready to flip. Ping me in this thread when canary starts. :thumbsup:
Marco (release-lead): Pinged. Leaving last-minute checklist here: [x] infra health, [x] runbook accessible, [x] rollback pinned, [ ] QA smoke owner ready, [ ] perf monitor on.
Jen (platform QA): QA ready — will post results. :white_check_mark:
Sanjay (infra): Perf dashboards bookmarked.
Marco (release-lead): Great. Final call: any objections to starting at T+45?
Jen (platform QA): No objections.
Tara (oncall): Go for it from my side.
Marco (release-lead): Alright launching at T+45. Will update thread at canary start and after smoke.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated by marco at 1905556761. Logs: https://deploys.internal/release/rc-3/canary
Jen (platform QA): Canary smoke started. Posting quick results in 6m.
Marco (release-lead): Thanks team — keep this thread for commit notes and quick rollbacks.
